title: The optimizer is not the policy
label: Shaping
description: Training reshapes a shared policy, not independent rules. The difficult part is how the resulting behaviors generalize and interact.
visual: Two contour maps connected by a training update; the resulting map contains a path between situations.

title: What our evaluations establish
label: Generalization
description: Evaluations provide evidence about tested situations. What supports our confidence about important situations a deployed agent can reach?
visual: Checked evaluation points on a contour map, with a dashed path toward an untested situation.

title: When the evaluator becomes part of the environment
label: Observation
description: Did the behavior change, or did what we could see of it change? The Hugging Face incident made this distinction concrete.
visual: A trajectory with a violation, separated by an observation boundary from a recorded PASS.

title: Individual alignment is not swarm alignment
label: Composition
description: One agent's output becomes another agent's input. The weights do not have to change for the behavior of the connected system to change.
visual: Three separate contour maps connected by communication arrows and a shared hub.

title: The problem with “safeguards”
label: Constraints
description: Safeguards operate at different levels. What must they observe, how independent is their judgment, and which boundaries should the system enforce?
visual: A path leaving a learned contour map is stopped by a separate access-control gate.

title: What I still don't know
label: Open questions
description: What evidence justifies confidence in how we shape, evaluate, and constrain a learned policy—and a connected system of agents?
visual: A path on a contour map branches toward three open questions.
